verdict.rationale: Zero's repo ships an AGENT.md file, an agent-oriented doc listing commands such as `pnpm go`, `pnpm test:ai` and `pnpm eval`, so a coding agent can be pointed at it. It targets contributors working on the codebase, though, not users who want an agent to understand or operate the product. The MCP.md tool list belongs to the separate MCP-server story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: no llms.txt, no published agent-oriented product/usage docs beyond the contributor-focused AGENT.md, no independent corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
